title: Tenant degradation scorecard & admission policy tracer for graceful multi-region failover
creator: Elena Park
description:
Problem: We lack a deterministic view that ties per-tenant degradation (partial failures / admitted token drops) to the admission controller policies and cross-region failover decisions. During recent incidents customers experienced silent quality regressions because load-shedding was visible as higher p95 but not correlated back to admission score changes or KV/cache miss storms.

Goal: Build a 'Tenant Degradation Scorecard' dashboard plus an 'Admission Policy Tracer' panel that makes it easy to answer: which tenants lost QoS, why (admit-rate, early-exit, kv-hit dip, model fallback), when did the admission policy change, and what circuit decisions triggered cross-region rerouting.

Scope and deliverables (high level):
- Instrumentation additions: per-tenant admit_rate, admit_evict_rate, early_exit_counts, kv_prefetch_hit_ratio, prefix_kv_hit_by_tenant, model_variant_fallback_count, region_failover_trigger_count. All metrics tagged with region, shard, model, tenant_id, priority_path.
- Derived SLIs: token_p50/p95/p99_by_tenant, admitted_token_ratio_by_tenant, kv_miss_burst_indicator (binary timeseries), circuit_state_transitions_by_shard.
- Dashboard: Tenant scorecard row per tenant with sparkline for admitted_token_ratio, token_p95, kv_hit_pct, and an alert icon when admission policy changed in last 15m. Admission Policy Tracer panel that shows policy diffs (old->new), time, who deployed change, and correlated circuit transitions and failover decisions.
- Queries and alerting: example Datadog and PromQL queries for SLO burn-rate windows and golden-signal correlation panels.
- Runbook update: troubleshooting steps to determine whether to throttle, reroute, or increase reserved capacity for a tenant.

Non-goals: exhaustive tenant billing UI, or automating policy rollbacks (may follow in a separate project).
acceptance_criteria: New per-tenant metrics (admit_rate, admitted_token_ratio, early_exit_counts, kv_prefetch_hit_ratio) are emitted from admission-controller and visible in metrics backend
Tenant Degradation Scorecard Grafana dashboard is deployed to production dashboards and grouped by tenant tag with pagination/filters
Admission Policy Tracer links policy diffs to circuit_state_transitions and region_failover_trigger_count within a ±5 minute correlation window
Three synthetic scenarios exercised: kv hitstorm, shard overload, and region outage — show expected scorecard signals and tracer entries
Runbook section added and tested with oncall during a tabletop exercise
